title: Universe and galaxy take shape
note: Canon gives no age for the universe or the galaxy; the anchor is a placeholder that only keeps the earliest events in order.
summary: Eons before any recorded history, the universe begins to form, and the galaxy gathers around a giant black hole at its heart, the region later called the Galactic Centre.
sources: Smuggler's Run: A Han Solo & Chewbacca Adventure

title: Midi-chlorians arise on the Wellspring of Life
note: Undated in canon. Placeholder anchor after the galaxy's formation, following the order of Wookieepedia's prehistory list.
summary: Midi-chlorians, microscopic life forms dwelling in every living thing, originate on the Wellspring of Life, an uncharted world in the Deep Core. They bind living beings to the Force and let them sense what it wills.

title: The Ones make their home on Mortis
note: Undated; the Father is said to have kept the balance 'for eons'. Placeholder anchor that follows Wookieepedia's list order.
summary: Three beings of immense Force power, a Father with his Son and Daughter, come to dwell on Mortis, a planet-like realm within the Force. The Son embodies the dark side, the Daughter the light; the Father holds them in balance.

title: Kyber crystals form within Ilum
yText: billions of years before the Imperial Era
note: The source says only 'billions of years' before the Imperial Era; anchored at two billion as a floor.
summary: Over billions of years, minerals seep into the rock of the planet Ilum, seeding its caverns with rare Force-attuned kyber crystals that will one day give Jedi lightsabers their blades.

title: Far-galaxy travelers build the Seatos reflex point
note: Undated. Wookieepedia's timeline lists it among undated ancient events ahead of its 100,000 BBY entries, so it is anchored there; it could be far older or younger.
summary: Visitors from another galaxy raise a reflex point in a henge on Seatos, charting the way home to Peridea. These people come to be called the Dathomiri; their Nightsister descendants later keep a star map to Peridea on Arcana.

title: Coruscant's first city levels rise
summary: On Coruscant, in the Core, builders lay the planet's earliest city tiers, beginning a building project that will one day cover the entire world in a single sprawling city.
sources: Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 26

title: The hyperdrive is invented
note: Undated. Wookieepedia's timeline puts it after the 57,000 BBY settlement of Utapau and before the c. 30,000 BBY Devaronian explorers, who built their own drives; anchored at that later bound.
summary: After ages of slow generation ships and sleeper ships, scientists studying the purrgil, space-dwelling creatures that leap between star systems, work out how to reach hyperspace. The resulting hyperdrive opens the galaxy to fast interstellar travel.

title: The Jedi Order is founded on Ahch-To
summary: At a Force nexus on remote Ahch-To, the figure later revered as the Prime Jedi establishes the Jedi Order to keep peace and justice, raising the first Jedi Temple; a village grows on the island soon after. The Dai Bendu are among its forerunners.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi
Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary

title: A Jedi scout discovers Ilum
summary: Shortly after the Order's founding, a Jedi scout reaches the frozen world of Ilum by steering through hyperspace with the Force, finding a planet that will become central to Jedi tradition.

title: The droid Huyang is activated
summary: The droid Huyang is built and begins serving the Jedi. For thousands of years he will guide younglings as they assemble their first lightsabers, and he will outlast the Order itself.

title: The Galactic Republic is founded
summary: Twenty-two Core Worlds, among them Alderaan, band together as the Core Founders and form the Galactic Republic, a union that will spread its rule across the galaxy over the coming millennia.
sources: The High Republic: The Rising Storm
conflict: Wookieepedia's main timeline, citing Star Wars: Timelines and The Rising Storm, dates the founding to c. 25,000 BBY; its Galactic Republic article instead gives a window from c. 25,000 BBY (The Star Wars Book) to c. 20,000 BBY (Star Wars: Timelines).

title: Great trade routes open the galaxy
summary: During the Expansionist Period after the Republic's founding, the Perlemian Trade Route, the Corellian Run and the Corellian Trade Spine are laid out, major hyperlanes binding the Core Worlds to distant regions.
sources: Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 29

title: The Ordu Aspectu fall at Garn
summary: The Ordu Aspectu, a Jedi splinter sect led by Rur that sought immortality, makes peace with the Jedi after the Entruvia Conflict. When Jedi inspectors arrive, an AI copy of Rur turns the citadel's droids on everyone; Rur dies stopping it.

title: Ossus becomes the Jedi cultural heart
note: Nexus of Power says Ossus had been the Jedi's cultural center for 12,000 years before the Imperial Era.
summary: According to Jedi tradition, the world Ossus becomes the Order's cultural center, a place of learning that nearly every Jedi is expected to visit on pilgrimage.

title: Stybla unification forges the Chiss Ascendancy
summary: Far out in the Unknown Regions, the Stybla family unites the Chiss Great Families and becomes the first Ruling Family, founding the Chiss Ascendancy, a secretive state whose code forbids its forces from striking first.

title: The Hundred-Year Darkness births the Sith
note: Star Wars: Timelines dates the schism to about 5000 BBY; Wookieepedia's main timeline leaves it undated.
summary: A rogue Jedi who believes true power lies in the dark side breaks from the Order with his followers. After the schism called the Hundred-Year Darkness they are driven into exile on Korriban, later Moraband, and become the Sith.

title: The Sith Wars
summary: For roughly four thousand years, successive Sith empires battle the Republic and its Jedi defenders, wielding slave armies and kyber-powered superweapons; even the distant Chiss are drawn in. The wars end only with the Sith's apparent destruction.

title: Naga Sadow's Great Hyperspace War
note: Known through the Qel-Droma Epics, an in-universe account of uncertain reliability.
summary: In the Qel-Droma Epics, a semi-legendary chronicle, Naga Sadow, a Sith Lord, launches the Great Hyperspace War against the Republic and its Jedi, beginning with an invasion of the Deep Core world Empress Teta. The Sith are beaten back.

title: The Sith seize Coruscant and raise a shrine
note: Tarkin has the shrine abandoned for close to 5,000 years by 14 BBY; Wookieepedia's battle article allows any date from c. 5000 to 1032 BBY.
summary: Back from exile, the Sith make war on the Republic and capture its capital, Coruscant, building a black shrine over a Force vergence on a sacred mountain. The Jedi eventually retake the world and raze the shrine, though a hidden part of it endures.

title: The Great Jedi Library rises on Ossus
note: Dated via the Qel-Droma Epics as retold in Nexus of Power.
summary: The Qel-Droma Epics credit Jedi Master Odan-Urr with overseeing the founding of the Great Jedi Library of Ossus, which for close to a millennium houses the Order's gathered knowledge.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

title: The Massassi build Yavin 4's Great Temple
summary: On the jungle moon Yavin 4, Massassi warriors, reportedly under Naga Sadow's command, raise the stone Great Temple. Some five millennia later the Rebel Alliance will hide its main base inside it.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope
Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 23

title: The Starflash saves Csilla at terrible cost
summary: Cornered at their homeworld by an unnamed enemy, the Chiss fire the Starflash, a one-shot alien superweapon of great age that consumes its twenty operators. The enemy fleet is annihilated, but the blast cools Csilla's sun and freezes the planet's surface.

title: Grizmallt refugees settle Naboo
summary: Humans escaping Grizmallt's civil war make a new home on Naboo, a Mid Rim world their explorers found nearly a century earlier. They fight the native Gungans for decades before the two peoples agree to keep apart.

title: Naboo's Time of Suffering
summary: Calling themselves the Naboo, the planet's human settlers split into rival city-states that war with one another for over three thousand years. Meanwhile the Gungan tribes unite under Boss Gallo and begin building Otoh Gunga.

title: The Crusade of Krath
note: Known only from the Qel-Droma Epics as retold in Nexus of Power.
summary: The Qel-Droma Epics tell of the Crusade of Krath, in which a new Sith Empire cuts down thousands of Jedi, a war that ends only with the redemption of the fallen Jedi Ulic Qel-Droma.

title: The Cron Supernova devastates Ossus
summary: The Qel-Droma Epics say that Naga Sadow, a Sith Lord, sets off a supernova in the Cron Cluster, destroying the cluster and devastating Ossus, the Jedi world that houses the Great Jedi Library.

title: The Great Scourge of Malachor
note: Wookieepedia's article gives only a c. 5000-1032 BBY window; its timeline lists the battle after the c. 3966 BBY Sith accounts of Malachor's kyber weaponry, so it is anchored there.
summary: Jedi Knights assault Malachor's Sith temple, a combined battle station and superweapon; its activation turns everyone in the battle, Jedi and Sith alike, to stone. The Jedi then forbid travel to Malachor and purge it from their archives.

title: Freia Kallea blazes the Hydian Way
summary: Freia Kallea joins a string of shorter routes into the Hydian Way, a super-hyperroute that lets merchants and privateers cross the galaxy from end to end.
sources: Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 29

title: The Drengir ally with the Sith
summary: The Drengir, sentient carnivorous plants joined in a hive mind, ally with the Sith. The Sith later turn on them, imprisoning their Great Progenitor aboard an abandoned Amaxine space station and leaving the Drengir dormant for millennia.

title: The Temple of the Kyber rises on Jedha
yText: thousands of years before the Clone Wars
note: Undated; 'thousands of years' before the Clone Wars means no later than about 2022 BBY, used as the anchor.
summary: In the Holy City on Jedha, a frigid desert moon, builders raise the Temple of the Kyber. Sacred to the Church of the Force and kept by the Guardians of the Whills, it will stand until the Death Star's first test shot.
sources: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story
Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide

title: Jedi break the Zygerrian Slave Empire
yText: thousands of years before the Clone Wars
note: Undated; begun 'thousands of years' before the Clone Wars, so anchored no later than about 2022 BBY.
summary: After the Republic outlaws slavery, the Jedi Order fights the Zygerrian Slave Empire and dismantles its operations, shattering a regime that had sold slave labor across the galaxy for thousands of years and leaving Zygerrians with a lasting hatred of the Jedi.

title: An old Jedi distress code falls silent
note: In Overlords the code is said to have gone unused for over 2,000 years before the Clone Wars.
summary: A Jedi distress code falls out of use. More than two thousand years later the Ones of Mortis will broadcast it to lure Ahsoka Tano, Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi into their realm.

title: Darth Momin, the Sith sculptor
summary: Freed from prison and trained by Darth Shaa, the artist Momin later murders his teacher and roams the galaxy designing dark weapons. Two Jedi slay him as he levels a city with a superweapon, but his spirit lives on inside his mask.

title: Tarre Vizsla forges the Darksaber
summary: Tarre Vizsla, the Order's first Mandalorian Jedi, builds the Darksaber, a singular lightsaber with a black blade. After his death the Temple keeps it, yet it becomes the emblem of House Vizsla and of rule over Mandalore.
conflict: Wookieepedia's Darksaber article and main timeline read Star Wars: Timelines' c. 1050 BBY as the year the blade was made, while its Tarre Vizsla article reads the same date as when he entered the Order as a child.

title: The Mandalorian-Jedi War lays waste to Mandalore
yText: during the fall of the Old Republic (before 1032 BBY)
note: The war spans ages, back to legendary crusades; Wookieepedia's timeline places its final stage, which ruined Mandalore, in the fall of the Old Republic that ended in 1032 BBY. Anchor is approximate.
summary: Mandalorian warriors, whose armor and weapons grew out of their clashes with Force-wielders, fight the Jedi in a long series of wars, from legendary crusades to a final conflict that leaves Mandalore's surface livable only inside sealed domed cities.

title: House Vizsla steals the Darksaber
note: Dated only as 'sometime after 1050 BBY' during the fall of the Old Republic, which closed in 1032 BBY.
summary: As the Old Republic collapses, Mandalorians of House Vizsla raid the Jedi Temple on Coruscant and carry off the Darksaber. Their descendants will cut down many Jedi with it and use it to rule Mandalore.

title: Lady Corvax's ritual scorches Mustafar
note: Vader Immortal says the Corvaxes lived before the Galactic Republic; Wookieepedia takes that to mean before 1032 BBY, so this is a latest-possible anchor.
summary: When her husband is killed in an attack on lush Mustafar, Lady Corvax steals the Mustafarians' sacred Bright Star for a ritual to revive him. It fails; the crystal's energy shoves the planet onto a new orbit, leaving a volcanic wasteland that later attracts Sith.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

title: The Sith are defeated at Ruusan
summary: Weakened by infighting, the Sith's Brotherhood of Darkness is crushed by the Jedi at Ruusan, closing both the Jedi-Sith War and the long Sith Wars. The Sith, who had occupied Coruscant's Jedi Temple, are driven out and believed extinct.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace
Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy

title: The Four Masters build the Jedi Temple
summary: On Coruscant, the Four Masters build a new Jedi Temple over the buried remains of the Sith shrine, hoping to smother its dark power while drawing on the site's strength in the Force. It serves as the Order's headquarters for the next thousand years.
conflict: Star Wars: Timelines dates the modern Temple to c. 1032 BBY, but Star Wars: Complete Locations says it was rebuilt about two thousand years before the Empire's rise, with remnants of an older temple set into its base.

title: Darth Bane creates the Rule of Two
summary: Sole survivor of his order, Darth Bane decrees that only two Sith may exist at once, one master, one apprentice, hiding in the shadows while his Grand Plan quietly works toward the ruin of the Republic and its Jedi. He is later entombed on Moraband.
sources: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace

title: The modern Republic rises from the dark age
note: The Star Wars Book places the restoration 1,032 years before A New Hope, and Star Wars: Timelines has Valorum in office by 1032 BBY; Wookieepedia's timeline files the reformation loosely under c. 1000 BBY. Attack of the Clones' 'thousand years' refers to this Republic.
summary: With the Sith gone, the Old Republic reorganizes as the modern Republic, governed from Coruscant by a newly founded Galactic Senate. Its military is disbanded, Tarsus Valorum becomes the first Supreme Chancellor, and the preceding era is remembered as a dark age.
sources: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones
Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy

title: The Jedi build their temple on Ilum
note: Fallen Order, set in 14 BBY, calls the temple a thousand years old.
summary: The Jedi build a temple over the largest cave mouth in Ilum's mountains. It becomes a pilgrimage site and home of the Gathering, the rite in which younglings seek the kyber crystals for their first lightsabers.

title: The Massassi die out
summary: The Massassi, the temple-building people of Yavin 4 thought to have served the Sith, become extinct, leaving their great stone temples to the jungle.
conflict: Star Wars: Timelines puts the extinction around 1000 BBY, but in Doctor Aphra (2016) 3, set about 0 ABY, the Massassi are said to have been extinct for millennia.

title: Dai Bendu monks settle Kijimi
summary: The Dai Bendu Monastery is built on the snowbound world of Kijimi, and a settlement called Kijimiko grows up around it, the future Kijimi City.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary
conflict: Counting Poe Dameron: Free Fall's 'thousand years' back from 18 ABY gives c. 982 BBY for the city; The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary's thousand years before Kijimi's 35 ABY destruction gives c. 965 BBY for the monastery.

title: Maz Kanata is born
note: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary makes her 1,007 years old at the 34 ABY Starkiller incident.
summary: Maz Kanata is born. Force-sensitive and extraordinarily long-lived, she will become a legendary pirate queen whose castle on Takodana shelters smugglers for centuries.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

title: The Galactic Accord of Systems
summary: After the war with the Sith and the Republic's reformation, the Galactic Accord of Systems lays down rules of engagement for future wars, among them that an enemy who wishes to surrender must be allowed to.

title: Yoda is born
summary: Yoda is born, a member of a small, long-lived species whose homeworld he never reveals. Over nine centuries he will become the Jedi Order's revered Grand Master and teacher of generations of Jedi.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi

title: Maz Kanata makes Takodana her home
summary: Maz Kanata makes her home on the forested world of Takodana. Her ancient castle there becomes a neutral haven where smugglers and spacers can rest and trade.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens
conflict: Star Wars: Timelines dates her settling to c. 873 BBY, but in The Force Awakens Han Solo says she has run her watering hole for a thousand years.

title: Naboo enters the Republic
summary: Naboo becomes part of the Republic; each year its people will celebrate the anniversary with the Festival of Light.

title: King Jafan unites Naboo and founds Theed
summary: General Jafan ends Naboo's Time of Suffering, bringing its feuding city-states together through military might and sheer will. Crowned king, he founds Theed and its Royal Palace that same year, beginning Naboo's Great Time of Peace.

title: Yoda begins training Jedi
summary: Yoda takes on his first students. He will instruct Jedi for some eight hundred years, down to Luke Skywalker on Dagobah.
sources: Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back

title: Jabba the Hutt is born
summary: The Hutt Jabba comes into the world on Nal Hutta, a scion of Desilijic Tiure, one of the influential Hutt crime clans called kajidics. Over six centuries he will build a criminal empire run from Tatooine.

title: The Republic builds the Citadel for rogue Jedi
summary: On Lola Sayu, the Republic builds the Citadel, a prison for rogue Jedi set on a bridge between lakes of lava and powered by geothermal heat. Around 520 BBY it takes in the last rogue Jedi on record.
sources: Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy

title: Yaddle is born
summary: Yaddle, who shares Yoda's species, is born. She will grow into a Jedi Master and join the Council that leads the Order.
sources: Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded

title: The High Republic Era
summary: The Republic at its zenith and the Jedi at their height push out into the Outer Rim frontier: an age of exploration, great building works and relative peace, later shaken by the Path of the Open Hand, the Nihil and hidden Sith.
sources: The High Republic: Light of the Jedi

title: The Path of the Open Hand is founded
summary: Breaking with the Guardians of the Whills on Jedha, the priest Sachar Rold starts a new sect on Dalna: the Path of the Open Hand, which holds that no one should wield the Force at all.
sources: Star Wars: The High Republic Character Encyclopedia

title: Barnabas Vim shatters the Echo Stone
summary: Seeking the legendary Echo Stone, which magnifies bonds with the Force, Jedi Master Barnabas Vim and Padawan Vix Fonnick find it on Angcord, tainted by the dark side. They break it into three shards and part ways to hide them.
sources: The High Republic Adventures: Quest of the Jedi
Star Wars: The High Republic Character Encyclopedia

title: Pathfinder teams push into the Outer Rim
summary: Co-Chancellors Kyong Greylark and Orlen Mollo send out Pathfinder teams, pairing Republic explorers with Jedi, to chart the Outer Rim and extend the Republic's reach into the lawless Galactic Frontier.

title: The Eiram and E'ronoh War
summary: When Niko A'lbaran, a prince of E'ronoh, dies on a mission to Eiram, the twin worlds' Forever War flares anew. A Republic summit betroths heirs Xiri A'lbaran and Phan-tu Zenn, but fighting flares until a treaty is sealed on their shared moon, Eirie.

title: The Great Hyperspace Rush
note: Wookieepedia's article ends the rush somewhere between c. 350 and c. 330 BBY; y2 is a midpoint.
summary: Prospectors race to map and claim hyperspace routes through the barely charted Outer Rim, making hyperlane travel safer and lifting the prospecting clans San Tekka and Graf to wealth and power.
sources: The High Republic: A Test of Courage
The High Republic: Path of Deceit

title: The Path unleashes the Great Leveler
summary: On Dalna the Path of the Open Hand hatches the Great Leveler, a Force-devouring Nameless beast. It petrifies two Jedi, Zallah Macri and Kevmo Zink, who were tracking the Rod of Seasons, an artifact Yana Ro then uses to command it.
sources: The High Republic: Path of Deceit

title: Porter Engle becomes the Blade of Bardotta
summary: Jedi Porter Engle and his sister Barash Silvain help drive a mercenary army from besieged Firevale on Gansevor; Silvain, blaming herself for the losses, distances herself from the Order. Engle later breaks a siege of Bardotta, winning fame as the Blade of Bardotta.

title: Pirate queen Maz Kanata battles the Dank Graks
summary: Maz Kanata, now a pirate queen, fights a turf war with the Dank Graks, a gang of castoffs from dark-side cults led by the Geonosian Arkik Von. Padawan Sav Malagán joins Maz undercover, and the Graks are finally beaten on Takodana.
wp: Turf war with the Dank Graks

title: The Battle of Jedha
summary: A Jedha summit meant to end the Eiram-E'ronoh war is bombed, and the Path of the Open Hand looses the Great Leveler on a Holy City riot. Fighting spreads, but Vildar Mac and Tey Sirrek stop the Path stealing the Rod of Daybreak.
sources: The High Republic: The Battle of Jedha
The High Republic: Path of Vengeance

title: The Night of Sorrow on Dalna
summary: Jedi and Republic envoys investigating the Path on Dalna are ambushed; its militant wing, the Path of the Closed Fist, sets Nameless creatures on them and many Jedi die. Helped by fighters from Eiram and E'ronoh, the Jedi finally crush the cult.
sources: The High Republic: Path of Vengeance

title: Marda Ro founds the Nihil
summary: Discovering that the Path's Mother, Elecia Zeveron, was secretly Force-sensitive, Marda Ro turns the Great Leveler on her. She then leaves Dalna and gathers a band of marauders that grows into the Nihil.
sources: The High Republic: Path of Vengeance

title: Yoda and Creighton Sun bury the Nameless secret
summary: After the slaughter on Dalna, Yoda and Master Creighton Sun decide to keep the Nameless, Force-draining creatures, a secret so that no one can turn them on the Jedi. The secret holds until the Nihil wield them some 150 years later.

title: The Ro family abducts Mari San Tekka
summary: Mari San Tekka, a San Tekka girl gifted with the ability to sense routes through hyperspace, is seized by an Evereni of the Ro family. Her secret Paths will later let the Nihil strike and vanish at will.

title: The Techno Union takes over Mustafar
summary: Mustafar falls under the control of the Techno Union, which rents the volcanic world back to its native Mustafarians and supplies the machinery they use to mine it. Their labor pays the rent, and Mustafar becomes a mining hub.
sources: Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

title: Asgar Ro becomes Eye of the Nihil
summary: Impatient for war on the Republic, Asgar Ro kills his mother Shalla aboard the Gaze Electric. He then reveals the hyperspace Paths secretly supplied by Mari San Tekka, has his son Marchion prove them in battle, and names himself Eye of the Nihil.
sources: The High Republic: Eye of the Storm 1

title: Marchion Ro kills his father, seizes the Nihil
summary: Believing Asgar Ro's son will be easier to manipulate, the Tempest Runners plot against the Eye, and Lourna Dee stabs him. Marchion finds his dying father and finishes him himself, becoming Eye of the Nihil and proving far harder to control.

title: Lina Soh wins the chancellorship
summary: Lina Soh of Daghee wins election as Supreme Chancellor, promising to extend the Republic's reach. Her Great Works, from mass-produced bacta to Starlight Beacon, aim to bind the galaxy together and draw in the Outer Rim.
sources: The High Republic: Light of the Jedi

title: The Nihil conflict
summary: Beginning with the Great Hyperspace Disaster and ending in their surrender at Eriadu, the Nihil wage four years of raids, terror and conquest on the Republic and its Jedi, at their height destroying Starlight Beacon and walling off the Occlusion Zone.
sources: The High Republic: Light of the Jedi
The High Republic: The Fallen Star
The High Republic: Trials of the Jedi

title: The Great Hyperspace Disaster
summary: The freighter Legacy Run is torn apart in hyperspace after meeting a Nihil ship, and its wreckage erupts into realspace as deadly projectiles. Jedi and Republic forces race to shield the Hetzal system. Marchion Ro and his Nihil are secretly behind the catastrophe.
sources: The High Republic: Light of the Jedi
The High Republic: The Rising Storm

title: The Nihil overrun Tanalorr
note: Wookieepedia places it in 232 BBY because it falls between the Great Hyperspace Disaster and the end of the Emergences.
summary: While the Jedi assess Tanalorr as a possible training world, the Nihil strike without warning and overwhelm its defenders. The Jedi Council gives up the planet, and Jedi Knight Dagan Gera, embittered by the loss, eventually betrays the Order.
sources: Star Wars: The High Republic: Chronicles of the Jedi

title: Stranded Jedi awaken the Drengir
summary: Thrown from hyperspace by the Great Disaster, a group of Jedi and the Vessel's crew shelter on an old Amaxine station. Under Nihil attack they destroy a set of statues, releasing the Drengir the Sith had sealed inside long ago.
sources: The High Republic: Into the Dark

title: Starlight Beacon is dedicated
summary: Starlight Beacon, a Republic station with a Jedi temple at its heart, built as a Great Work to guide travelers and relay signals across the Outer Rim, is dedicated before Chancellor Soh, Yoda and Pra-Tre Veter, with Avar Kriss as marshal.
sources: The High Republic: Light of the Jedi

title: Young Jedi defend the Tenoo temple
summary: Aiming to push the Jedi out of the Bri'ahl sector, Gangul chief Sellaccc Orryak seizes the Tenoo Jedi Temple, but Padawan Wes Vinik, youngling Kai Brightstar and their friends rally allies and win it back.

title: The Drengir crisis
summary: Revived Drengir spread through the Outer Rim, preying on Sedri Minor and overrunning Hutt cities on Nal Hutta. Jedi and Hutts join forces, and Avar Kriss leads a strike on the Drengir homeworld Mulita that captures their Great Progenitor.
sources: The High Republic: The Rising Storm

title: The Nihil strike the Republic Fair on Valo
summary: Chancellor Soh's Republic Fair on Valo, staged to show the galaxy's recovery from the Great Disaster, is ravaged by a Nihil assault while the Jedi are distracted. The raiders are repelled, but hundreds of thousands die.
sources: The High Republic: The Rising Storm
The High Republic: Race to Crashpoint Tower

title: Loden Greatstorm dies at the Battle of Grizal
summary: Jedi track Nihil raiders home to Grizal and storm their base. Marchion Ro sets the Great Leveler loose, and it kills Loden Greatstorm, long a Nihil captive, before his Padawan Bell Zettifar; the Jedi leave believing Lourna Dee leads the Nihil.
sources: The High Republic: The Rising Storm

title: Gravity's Heart falls; Mari San Tekka dies
summary: Republic and Jedi forces destroy Gravity's Heart, a Nihil station housing Chancey Yarrow's gravity-well weapon, and free captive Jedi. Dying, the Nihil's navigator Mari San Tekka hands Vernestra Rwoh one last hyperspace route.
sources: The High Republic: Out of the Shadows

title: The Nihil destroy Dalna
summary: Nihil scientist Zadina Mkampa uses a crystal matrix buried in Dalna's crust to trigger quakes and volcanic devastation. Imri Cantaros helps organize a rescue in which Starlight Beacon itself is hauled across hyperspace to evacuate the Dalnans.
sources: The High Republic: Mission to Disaster

title: Marchion Ro captures Nameless on Planet X
summary: Guided by his family's lore, Marchion Ro sacrifices waves of Nihil strikeships to distract the storm veil around Planet X, slips through with his loyal She'ar, and wields the Rod of Seasons to seize a clutch of Nameless.
sources: The High Republic: Eye of the Storm 2

title: Starlight Beacon falls
summary: Nihil saboteurs and Nameless creatures cripple Starlight Beacon, and the station plunges onto Eiram. Stellan Gios gives his life steering it clear of Barraza City. Marchion Ro then steps into the open, proclaiming to the whole galaxy that he leads the Nihil.
sources: The High Republic: The Fallen Star
The High Republic: Trail of Shadows 5

title: The Stormwall seals the Occlusion Zone
summary: Deploying stormseeds, the Nihil raise the Stormwall, a barrier impassable to hyperspace travel and communications, and enclose ten sectors, Valo among them, in their Occlusion Zone. A Republic fleet is lost, and Avar Kriss is among the Jedi trapped inside.
sources: The High Republic – Shadows of Starlight 1
The High Republic: Eye of the Storm 2
The High Republic: Escape from Valo

title: The Jedi invoke the Guardian Protocols
summary: A week after Starlight's fall, with most Jedi already recalled to Coruscant, the Council puts the Guardian Protocols into effect, fast-tracking learners through the ranks and readying the Order for open war on the Nihil.
sources: The High Republic – Shadows of Starlight 1

title: Marchion Ro executes Grand Master Pra-Tre Veter
summary: Marking a year since Starlight's fall, Marchion Ro has Grand Master Pra-Tre Veter, captured months earlier in a Nihil ambush on Asternin, put to death on a live broadcast.
sources: The High Republic: The Eye of Darkness

title: The Nihil occupy Naboo
summary: Forces under Nihil General Abediah Viess conquer Naboo, and its queen escapes into hiding. Jedi and Republic troops led by Avar Kriss later free the planet, though Viess slips away.
sources: The High Republic: Temptation of the Force

title: The Battle of Eriadu ends the Nihil conflict
summary: Republic fleets, Jedi and furious Eriaduans rallied by the Tarkin family, joined by Hutt, Togruta and Mon Calamari forces, fight the Nihil occupiers for Eriadu. The Nihil surrender, General Viess and the Warden die, and the Nihil conflict ends.
sources: The High Republic: Trials of the Jedi

title: The Luminous Nine on Planet X
summary: Nine Jedi and former Jedi carry the Nameless home to Planet X to halt the blight. Marchion Ro kills the creatures and wrecks his flagship, dropping the Stormwall, but is captured; Avar Kriss and Elzar Mann stay to hold the blight in check.
sources: The High Republic: Trials of the Jedi

title: Marchion Ro is tried and imprisoned
summary: Put on trial in the Senate Building on Coruscant for crimes including Starlight Beacon's destruction, Marchion Ro receives a life sentence of solitary confinement, his prison to be built by droids at a random spot in deep space.
sources: The High Republic: Trials of the Jedi

title: Mostima and Sean expose Land & Sky
summary: Jedi Master Mostima and her Padawan Sean look into a killing in the far-flung Aakaash system and expose how deeply Land & Sky, the corporation that governs it, is corrupted.

title: Chewbacca is born
note: In Solo: A Star Wars Story, set around 10 BBY, he gives his age as 190.
summary: The Wookiee Chewbacca is born on his people's homeworld, Kashyyyk. Some two centuries on he will fly the Millennium Falcon as Han Solo's partner and co-pilot.

title: The Jedi Annexation Act fails
note: The Acolyte: Wayseeker, set about 160 BBY, places the attempt three years earlier.
summary: Senator Jakob Garn tries to push the Jedi Annexation Act through the Senate, a bill that would fold the Order into the Republic as a formal branch under Senate oversight. It fails to pass.

title: Osha and Mae Aniseya are born on Brendok
note: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide makes Osha 24 in 132 BBY.
summary: On Brendok, the witch Aniseya uses a Force vergence to create twin daughters, Osha and Mae, whom her partner Koril carries and bears. The girls are raised within the coven's fortress.
sources: Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide

title: Tragedy on Brendok
note: Set sixteen years before The Acolyte, which is placed in 132 BBY (a century before The Phantom Menace).
summary: Investigating a Force vergence on Brendok, Jedi Sol, Indara, Torbin and Kelnacca find a coven raising twin girls. Their attempt to take Osha for training ends in fire and killings that destroy the coven; Osha joins the Order believing Mae dead.

title: Mae becomes the Stranger's acolyte
note: The Visual Guide says she began training two years before the series' 132 BBY events.
summary: Mae Aniseya, secretly alive, becomes apprentice to a Sith Lord called only the Stranger, who poses as the antiques dealer Qimir. He schools her in dark-side lore and bladework, and aims her revenge at the Brendok Jedi.
sources: Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide

title: Mae murders Jedi Master Indara
note: The Acolyte is dated to 132 BBY as a century before The Phantom Menace.
summary: Sent to avenge Brendok, Mae kills Jedi Master Indara in a noodle shop on Ueda. The Jedi, with no record of Mae, arrest her twin Osha, now a ship mechanic, until Master Sol comes to believe Mae survived.

title: The Stranger slaughters the Jedi on Khofar
summary: After Torbin's death on Olega, Mae balks at killing Kelnacca on Khofar, but the Stranger kills him anyway. He then wipes out the Jedi team that arrives too late, including Jecki Lon and Yord Fandar; only Sol and Osha survive.

title: Sol dies on Brendok; the Jedi cover up
summary: Back on Brendok, Sol admits killing the twins' mother, and Osha strikes him down. The Stranger wipes Mae's memory and takes Osha as his apprentice. Vernestra Rwoh blames the Jedi deaths on Sol to head off a Senate inquiry.

title: A treaty shields Mandalore from Republic invasion
note: Only known to be in force at least a century before the 19 BBY Siege of Mandalore.
summary: By now a treaty forbids the Republic to invade Mandalore. A century later, the Republic-backed campaign to oust Maul from Mandalore will be called a breach of it.

title: Dooku is born on Serenno
summary: Dooku is born into House Serenno. Alarmed by the baby's Force powers, Count Gora leaves him in the forest outside the palace, where a Jedi seeker finds him and brings him to the Jedi on Coruscant. He will become Count Dooku.

title: Sifo-Dyas is born
summary: On Minashee, Sifo-Dyas is born. Raised a Jedi alongside Dooku, he will one day secretly order the clone army that fights the Clone Wars.
